sha="e48824521f6cedc154e4ef36ebf4fc2c4735f182"
data=urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.github.com/repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/tarball/"+sha,timeout=12).read(800001)
assert len(data)<800001
tar=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode="r:gz")
src={f.name.split("/",1)[1]:tar.extractfile(f).read().decode() for f in tar.getmembers() if f.isfile()}
for name,body in src.items():
 if name.endswith(".py"): compile(body,name,"exec")
runtime=types.ModuleType("runtime");runtime.__path__=[];sys.modules["runtime"]=runtime
mod=types.ModuleType("runtime.model_gate");mod.__file__="/tmp/ai-core/runtime/model_gate.py";sys.modules["runtime.model_gate"]=mod
exec(compile(src["runtime/model_gate.py"],mod.__file__,"exec"),mod.__dict__)
test=types.ModuleType("test_model_gate");test.__file__="/tmp/ai-core/tests/test_model_gate.py";test.__name__="test_model_gate"
exec(compile(src["tests/test_model_gate.py"],test.__file__,"exec"),test.__dict__)
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(test.CoordinatorTests)
runner=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1)
result=runner.run(suite)
print("AI_CORE_COORDINATOR_SOURCE_SHA="+sha+" TESTS="+str(result.testsRun)+" FAIL="+str(len(result.failures))+" ERR="+str(len(result.errors)))
assert result.wasSuccessful()'
